risk_note: RV2 (orders/**; money path ports). orders declares the rights and hold command ports implemented by settlement (B2-04l): rights.record, rebate.adminHold and rebate.adminUnhold pass the caller's transaction, input, result and errors through unchanged and fail with ORDERS_RIGHTS_PORT_UNAVAILABLE without touching the database when not injected; guards, CAS, dedupe (order_rights unique key, D10-169 K-2, table in B1-09e) and bookkeeping stay on the settlement side. The read-only sub-order lookup matches within app_id and platform; for PDD both sides are compared hyphen-free (stored order_sn is verbatim), with no assumed number format; a parent-only number is reported as sub_order_no_missing, never expanded. Follow-up: app.orders has no index on sub_order_id / parent_order_id, so a 10,000-row import scans per row (followups, B1-09e or a migration task).
